ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hello Luck uses the camera to find luck in clover patches. Video is analyzed on your device only.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hello Luck saves where you found luck. It is made public only if you share it to the Lucky Map.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hello Luck uses your photos only when you share a luck card to an app like Instagram, so the card can be passed along.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Hello Luck saves your luck card or journey video to your photos when you choose to save it.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Hello Luck uses the motion sensors to keep the detection box steady while you move the camera.
